commits.summary: Verify the Spring 5.x cases of the P01-P30 brief on pinned slices and record all job results
commits.body:
The seven Spring 5.x cases (P05, P09, P11, P16, P18, P19, P23) cannot be built with Gradle: their build plugins are in no public repository. As the user asked, they are now checked the way the first Spring setup checked its A4. Each pin's changed production files are compiled with JDK 8 against the release whose copy of those files equals the parent pin's. The landed test class is then compiled from the pin's own test tree and run with the era's test libraries (resolved with checksums, signatures checked) on the JUnit Platform launcher. All seven pass on the fix slice; where the parent has its own version of the test class, it passes on the parent slice. The fix's tests fail on the parent slice, with the same failures on the stock release as a control. Class digests are recorded and identical over two runs. The whole route takes 30 s and runs inline in the probe cap.

The record also takes in the results of the remaining 16 setup jobs, which the runner recorded on another head (commit 933de3d18d34): the fifteen Spring 7.x cases and the P25 rerun. The landed regressions pass at every fix pin, and fail or do not compile at the parent for every case, except that P15's transplant fails one test and then blocks until the step's 3000 s timeout, so its job is recorded as failed. Also new: the digests of the built artifacts for all 23 Gradle cases, classpath sizes, current disk figures, and Setup Agent Notes updated for the finished state. Verified by reading each step log and result, by the slice runs and their release control, and by checking that all 61 worktrees are clean.
